in_marathi.name: Padala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's step
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Padala originates from the Sanskrit language and is derived from the word 'Padat' meaning 'to step'. This name symbolizes taking a step towards devotion and faith in Lord Vishnu. It is a powerful name believed to bring prosperity, strength, and protection.
